name: Engraved Establishment
storyline: Fazbear Entertainment has been looking for success in the current market after many poor business decisions and bad publicity. As a result, they’ve taken a bold risk and searched for someone to take the brand into a new age with a pizzeria chain and animatronic delivery service. They hope you’ll be the next step to get Fazbear Entertainment back on top!
summary: Engraved Establishment is a FNaF fangame that’s a tycoon by day and tower defense by night, with the goal to reach Fazbear Entertainment's quota. As your pizzeria evolves and changes to get more customers, so does the office you work in at night.
